scripts.build: next build && pnpm run build:prestart && pnpm run build:storage-init && pnpm run build:worker
scripts.build:worker: esbuild src/worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=.next/standalone/worker.mjs --external:pg-native --external:sharp --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:prestart: esbuild scripts/prestart.mjs --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=.next/standalone/scripts/prestart.mjs --external:../server.js --external:pg-native --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build:storage-init: esbuild scripts/storage-init.mjs --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=.next/standalone/scripts/storage-init.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
